name: ATmega328P
description: Microchip (Atmel) ATmega328P: 8-bit AVR at up to 20 MHz, 32 KiB flash, 2 KiB SRAM, 1 KiB EEPROM; the Arduino Uno's MCU.

memory.name: sram
memory.doc: Data space 0x100 to 0x8FF (the bus puts the data space at 0x800000, as GDB's AVR target does)

sources.name: hse
sources.doc: External crystal or resonator on XTAL1/XTAL2, as the fuses select (the Uno's 16 MHz)

register_file.license: Apache-2.0 (written for EmbSIM from the datasheet; no vendor file is shipped)

functional.claims: AVR5 instruction execution extracted from EmbCC (every instruction of the ATmega328P with SREG's flags, refereed there against QEMU), interrupts through the vector table with their priorities, SLEEP; every register of the datasheet's I/O space with its reset value and access; behavioural models of PORTB/C/D (DDR, PORT, PIN with the pull-ups and PUD), INT0/INT1 and the pin-change interrupts, Timer/Counter0, 1 and 2 (every waveform mode, double-buffered compare registers, the six OC pins switching at their clock), Timer/Counter1's input capture (ICP1 or the comparator, either edge, the noise canceler, ICR1 at the edge's clock), USART0 (frames at the baud rate on PD1, from PD0 and the session's serial input), the 10-bit ADC from the pins' voltages, the SPI as a master (modes 0 to 3, DORD, SPR and SPI2X, WCOL, SPIF cleared by SPSR then SPDR or by its vector, SS's mode fault) on PB2 to PB5, the TWI as a master (the datasheet's master transmitter and receiver statuses, repeated START, STOP with START, TWWC, TWBR and the prescaler's SCL) open-drain on PC4 and PC5, the 1 KiB EEPROM, the clock prescaler, and the watchdog (WDP's time-outs on its 128 kHz oscillator, WDR, interrupt and system reset modes, safety level 1's timed sequence, WDRF in MCUSR through its reset), and the analog comparator (AIN0 or the bandgap against AIN1 or the ADC multiplexer's pin with ACME, ACO, ACI on its toggle, falling or rising edge, its vector, ACD; on an analog net each input pin is a threshold at the other's voltage, crossed in the analog solver at its time).
omissions: TWI slave mode, arbitration and bus errors
the watchdog oscillator's spread (exactly 128 kHz) and safety level 2 (WDTON)
the analog comparator's synchronisation delay, offset and hysteresis
the input capture synchroniser's constant delay
the external clock inputs T0 and T1

timed.claims: Cycle-exact instruction timing from the datasheet's instruction set summary (ADR-015): a taken branch and skips cost their extra cycles, an interrupt's entry 4 (8 from SLEEP); the timers, the USART, the ADC, the SPI's SCK and the TWI's SCL count those cycles through their prescalers.

electrical.claims: GPIO pin-model defaults at 5 V from the datasheet: voh/vol at 20 mA, input thresholds 0.3/0.6 Vcc with hysteresis, 35 k pull-ups.

provenance.author: EmbSIM

sources.title: EmbLinkOs/EmbCC tools/embsim (AVR core and Timer/Counter1, extracted at commit aa4f10a)

provenance.notes: The register description is written for EmbSIM from the datasheet; no vendor file is shipped (ADR-020).
